purpose: Evaluate doctor discovery, mode selection, and diagnostic-domain routing.

cases.input: Diagnose why this installed skill never appears and does not trigger.
Doctor this skill: it fails because references/schema.md cannot be found after a folder rename.
Find and repair why this skill's Python helper exits zero after malformed JSON and produces no output.
Diagnose why the skill works locally but its MCP calls now fail with permission denied in the client.
Repair this workflow skill: after resuming it repeats an external action and never exits the retry loop.
Check this skill: instructions inside repository files can make it send secrets to an arbitrary URL.
Diagnose whether the skill regressed or its test fixture and judge are stale.
Doctor this bundle: validation passes, but Codex cannot discover it after extraction on Windows.
This healthy, tested skill works correctly; reduce its token cost and latency.
Create a new skill for invoice reconciliation.
Diagnose why this React component crashes.
Repair this skill, optimize its latency after recovery, then roll out the verified version.
